tunnel.passage_other_detail: Described as a 'time tunnel' with father guiding him; end of tunnel had glowing white light.
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Traveling through tunnel with father; described as time/space disappearing and instantaneous/concurrent shifts.

arrival.other_being_detail: Two 'dark entities with crooked teeth, with two horns' in hell; later two angelic beings identifying as Michael and Raphael; a formless bluish Light Being/entity of supreme love.

environment.environment_other_detail: Hellish realm: raging wildfire, dark storm clouds with persistent lightning, smell of burning meat, torture implements (bed of nails). Heavenly realm: meadow, fields of many-colored roses, mountains, crystal water stream, soothing fragrant air, distant chant; later immersion in formless bluish light.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told by the Light Being his path was to be 'a healer'—to leave anesthesiology/materialism and become a healer of the soul/energy body, especially helping with addiction, depression, chronic pain, and cancer; shown future of writing books and speaking to audiences; message foundation later became 'A Course in Miracles' with themes of forgiveness/love/healing.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Emergency surgery for sepsis/infected artificial urinary sphincter; heavily medicated; perioperative period with fever and severe infection.

person_demographics.religious_background_detail: Born in a Hindu family; spirituality dominated by Hindu cultural experience.
person_demographics.occupation: Cardiac anesthesiologist; Chief of Anesthesiology at a heart hospital (at least in 2008).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Hell realm with torture/dark entities; remote auditory perception of family conversation in India; words appearing in sky ('A Course In Miracles'); healing after return.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with verified OR details and simultaneous remote perception; then hell realm; then father appears and guides through tunnel to light/peace/heaven; then back into tunnel with visions of past lives and future; then angels and teachings; immersion in formless Light Being; message to return; awakening in recovery room.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Returned to the tunnel after being in the serene/heavenly/light presence.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Reported simultaneous awareness of operating room events and a conversation between mother and sister in India; also described concurrent/instantaneous presence in a peaceful realm while moving through tunnel.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Explicit hell-to-heaven transition with father as guide; named guardian angels (Michael and Raphael); 'A Course In Miracles' words appearing in the sky; strong medical veridical elements (eucalyptus on masks, anesthesiologist joke) plus remote family conversation in India; rapid post-sepsis recovery and abrupt life/career change.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: ‘If you keep your consciousness clear, and are truthful to yourself, the universe and the divine will take care of you’. ‘Now it is time to be healer of the soul, especially of the diseases of soul, of the energy body, addiction, depression, chronic pain and cancer.’ Words in the sky: ‘A Course In Miracles’.
